og.alt: State Machines: The spinner and the error, on screen together? Not any more. 34.7× faster send than XState 5.

hero.alt: Schematic of a createMachine fetcher with four states: idle, loading, success and error. Events FETCH, REJECT, RETRY, RESOLVE and RESET light the transition they take, one at a time. A side panel shows machine() and nextEvents() for the current state, and a FETCH sent while loading is ignored, so the spinner and the error are never on screen together.
